test.result: 17 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed. Aggregate one-way turnover band suppresses a bounded rebalance and rejects invalid bands.

implemented: The shared target portfolio accepts an explicit maximum aggregate one-way turnover band.
If proposed scheduled rebalance turnover is at or below the band, prior weights are retained and reported turnover/cost remain zero.
The signal allocator passes the band through to the shared portfolio optimizer.
blockers: The band is opt-in and no frozen per-strategy value is wired into all runner configurations.
Portfolio inputs do not yet separate market-price drift from signal changes, so band calibration must be evaluated with forward evidence.
No broad claim of fee-drift immunity or prospective cost reduction is made.
scope_note: A generic no-trade band is implemented at the common optimizer boundary; production policy and drift-specific validation remain outstanding.
